# Cleanrows

> Clean, structured data for recruiting, sales and marketing teams.

Cleanrows publishes paid Apify Store Actors that return structured rows of public data. Prices are pay-per-result with no start fee. This file is for language-model clients looking for the right tool.

Site: https://henryklimes.github.io/cleanrows-site/
Store profile: https://apify.com/henryklimes

## Actors

- [ATS Jobs Feed](https://apify.com/henryklimes/ats-jobs-feed): Open jobs from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters and Recruitee as one JSON feed. Price: $1.50 per 1,000 jobs.
- [Workday Jobs Feed](https://apify.com/henryklimes/workday-jobs-feed): Every opening on a myworkdayjobs.com career site, including boards past the 2,000-job cap, with pay ranges and exact posting dates. Price: $1.50 per 1,000 jobs.
- [Careers Page & ATS Detector](https://apify.com/henryklimes/careers-ats-detector): From a company domain, get the careers page, the ATS it uses, the board ID and how many jobs are open. Price: $3 per 1,000 domains.
- [Shopify & WooCommerce Products Feed](https://apify.com/henryklimes/ecommerce-products-feed): Full public store catalogs: prices, sale prices, variants, SKUs, stock and images, one schema. Price: $1 per 1,000 products.
- [Company Website Enricher](https://apify.com/henryklimes/company-enricher): A company profile read from the company's own website: emails, phones, socials, tech stack and ATS. Price: $4 per 1,000 companies.
- [Google Trends API – Bulk Keywords, Compare & Trending Now](https://apify.com/henryklimes/google-trends): Interest over time, by region, rising queries and Trending Now. Compare more than 5 keywords on one scale. A hosted pytrends alternative. Price: $0.25 per 1,000 keywords.
- [Google Ads Transparency API – Competitor Ads & Advertiser Check](https://apify.com/henryklimes/google-ads-transparency): Check whether a company runs Google Ads and export its ads: format, run dates, images and links. Paste a domain, a brand name or an advertiser ID. Price: $0.50 per 1,000 ads, $2 per 1,000 checks.
- [Screenshot & PDF API](https://apify.com/henryklimes/screenshot-pdf): Bulk URL to PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF, including full-page and mobile captures. Pay only for successful captures. Price: $2 per 1,000 captures.

## When to use which Actor

- Open jobs from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters or Recruitee: ATS Jobs Feed.
- Open jobs from a myworkdayjobs.com career site, including boards with more than 2,000 postings: Workday Jobs Feed.
- You have company domains and need the ATS name, careers URL, board ID or open-job count: Careers Page & ATS Detector.
- A public Shopify or WooCommerce catalog: Shopify & WooCommerce Products Feed.
- Company emails, phones, socials, tech stack from the company's own website: Company Website Enricher.
- Google Trends for many keywords, compare more than 5 terms, or Trending Now: Google Trends API (a pytrends alternative).
- Whether a company runs Google Ads, or export a competitor's ads from the Ads Transparency Center: Google Ads Transparency API.
- Bulk screenshots or URL-to-PDF: Screenshot & PDF API.

## Actor details

### ATS Jobs Feed
URL: https://apify.com/henryklimes/ats-jobs-feed
Price: $1.50 per 1,000 jobs
Open jobs from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters and Recruitee as one JSON feed.
Input: company or board identifiers for Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee. Output: normalized job rows (title, company, location, salary when published, apply URL, description optional). Not for Workday sites.

### Workday Jobs Feed
URL: https://apify.com/henryklimes/workday-jobs-feed
Price: $1.50 per 1,000 jobs
Every opening on a myworkdayjobs.com career site, including boards past the 2,000-job cap, with pay ranges and exact posting dates.
Input: myworkdayjobs.com career site URLs. Output: job rows including locations, remote type, pay range, posting date, description optional. Handles the 2,000-result cap by paging. Public endpoints, no login. If a site rate-limits every attempt, the run fails instead of returning an empty success.

### Careers Page & ATS Detector
URL: https://apify.com/henryklimes/careers-ats-detector
Price: $3 per 1,000 domains
From a company domain, get the careers page, the ATS it uses, the board ID and how many jobs are open.
Input: company domains. Output: careers URL, ATS name (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday and 20 more), board ID, open-job count. This detects the ATS; it does not scrape the jobs themselves.

### Shopify & WooCommerce Products Feed
URL: https://apify.com/henryklimes/ecommerce-products-feed
Price: $1 per 1,000 products
Full public store catalogs: prices, sale prices, variants, SKUs, stock and images, one schema.
Input: Shopify or WooCommerce store URLs. Output: products with prices, sale prices, variants, SKUs, stock, images, categories and tags. Uses public JSON endpoints, no login and no browser.

### Company Website Enricher
URL: https://apify.com/henryklimes/company-enricher
Price: $4 per 1,000 companies
A company profile read from the company's own website: emails, phones, socials, tech stack and ATS.
Input: company domains. Output: name, description, logo, business emails and phones, address, social profiles, tech stack, contact page, careers page, ATS and open-job count. Data is read from the company's own website, not a third-party database.

### Google Trends API – Bulk Keywords, Compare & Trending Now
URL: https://apify.com/henryklimes/google-trends
Price: $0.25 per 1,000 keywords
Interest over time, by region, rising queries and Trending Now. Compare more than 5 keywords on one scale. A hosted pytrends alternative.
Input: keywords (up to 500), optional compare mode, geos, time range, or Trending Now by country. Output: interest-over-time, interest-by-region, top and rising related queries, or trending rows. Compare mode can put more than 5 keywords on one scale. Related topics are best-effort and off by default because Google often returns them empty to automated clients.

### Google Ads Transparency API – Competitor Ads & Advertiser Check
URL: https://apify.com/henryklimes/google-ads-transparency
Price: $0.50 per 1,000 ads, $2 per 1,000 checks
Check whether a company runs Google Ads and export its ads: format, run dates, images and links. Paste a domain, a brand name or an advertiser ID.
Input: domains, brand names or Google advertiser IDs (up to 1,000), optional country, date window and formats. Output: a summary row per query (is_advertising, ad-count range, advertiser accounts, latest ad date) and one row per ad (format, first/last shown, days running, image or preview, link). Ad copy text is not extracted. Not-found and failed lookups are free.

### Screenshot & PDF API
URL: https://apify.com/henryklimes/screenshot-pdf
Price: $2 per 1,000 captures
Bulk URL to PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF, including full-page and mobile captures. Pay only for successful captures.
Input: a list of URLs plus format (PNG, JPEG, WebP, PDF), viewport or device preset, optional selector and wait strategy. Output: captured files. Failed captures are not billed.
